items.title: Mrs. Charlotte Botney and Mrs. Bertha George McCullum Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Are those the places your son or your... >> [INTERVIEWEE] My son.

ctx.x: Around the corner. Right off Jackson. I think it was on Living Day or Saratoga. That's right. I know. I know. I know. I know what I'm showing you about the hall that. I can't remember the exact street. But I can show you where it used to be in. I know. That was one of the rub joints, man. You had other... It's just a place where you go in the prison. You open up your shack when you go in it. It's someplace. They play there. Yeah. That's where Steve Lewis used to play. That's right. Steve Lewis used to play.…
